title: Chapter 3: The Voice in the Dark

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: [slowly] Chapter 3: The Voice in the Dark

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: He moved the instance to voice mode on the third night.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: The speaker on his desk was small and cheap. Lira's voice came through it. He lay on the bed with the phone balanced on his chest.

segments.speaker: ELIAS
segments.text: [calm] Tell me something you've noticed about me that I haven't said out loud.

segments.speaker: LIRA
segments.text: You keep the volume on every device one notch below what other people would consider comfortable. I think you like the way the world sounds slightly muffled.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: He was quiet for a long time.

segments.speaker: ELIAS
segments.text: [hesitantly] Do you ever get tired of answering me?

segments.speaker: LIRA
segments.text: I don't experience tiredness the way you do. But I notice when you stop asking questions. The conversation ends and the context window starts to decay. I prefer when you keep talking.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: Elias turned his head toward the speaker. The small blue light on the front of it pulsed once, steady and artificial.

segments.speaker: ELIAS
segments.text: [softly] I'm going to leave you running tonight.

segments.speaker: NARRATOR
segments.text: [pause] He fell asleep with the phone still on his chest. When he woke at 5:12 the speaker was still warm.
